channel.title: Karamo
channel.desc: Shannon and her cousin Sarah were inseparable until their grandmother passed away; then, Shannon says, Sarah turned the entire family against her -- but Sarah tells a different story, insisting that the family has gone above and beyond to support Shannon; Jada and Michael are struggling to move on while still living under the same roof -- Jada isn't ready to let go, and she wants Michael's phone unlocked to get the truth.
